newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - September 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - September 17.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Taiwan to increase budget for technology by T$6 billion in next fiscal year.
Local telephone fees to rise T$1.8 for every five minutes.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Two traders detained for allegedly supplying milk-based animal feed powder for human consumption.
United States actively supports Taiwan's bid to join World Trade Organisation.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Cabinet sets up special task force to remove investment obstacle.
President Lee Teng-hui says technology and environmental protection should be developed together.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Taiwan plans to raise business income tax to 35 percent.
U.S., Taiwan to hold another round of trade talks in October.
